items.title: 2.9 Ions aur free radicals ki electronic configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.9, printed page 40.

blocks.text: Atoms electrons kho kar ya le kar ions bante hain, aur kuch species ghair-jure (unpaired) electrons rakhti hain; un ki configurations atom ki configuration se nikalti hain. Agle do topics ions aur free radicals lete hain.

blocks.prompt: Aage parhne se pehle, atoms ki configurations se Mg2+ aur F- ki configuration ka andaza lagayein.
blocks.explanation: Magnesium 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 hai; do 3s electrons khone se Mg2+ 1s2 2s2 2p6 hai. Fluorine 1s2 2s2 2p5 hai; ek electron lene se F- 1s2 2s2 2p6 hai. Dono ions ki configuration neon wali hai.

items: Ions aur free radicals atom se nikli configurations se bayan hote hain: cations ke liye electrons hatayein, anions ke liye jorein, aur radicals mein ghair-jure electrons dhoondein.
